resources.string: DigAddFix observes the active app to interrupt apps on your blocklist, including other known browsers, and reads the address fields of Brave, Chrome, and Firefox to identify a blocked website. When you enable the protection lock, it also checks native activity names and view identifiers for known installer, store, settings, browser-preference and extension screens, and recognized internal browser settings addresses. It interrupts supported browsers if their DNS filter stops while locked. It shows a full-screen overlay for five seconds and returns you to Home. It does not read messages, passwords, or webpage body text. Personal-phone protection is best effort. Enable only if you want these protections.
